name: The Price Is Right
description: "Come on down!" The Price Is Right features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items.

The Price is Right at Night: Salutes Frontline and Essential Workers
videos.overview: On its newly designed, socially distanced set, current host Drew Carey welcomes frontline workers to play their favorite games.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with the Cast of The Neighborhood
videos.overview: For the first time ever, seven stars (i.e. Greenfield, Behrs, Cedric, Arnold, Spears, McKinney and Greenspan) as individual contestants play all six pricing games for The Boys and Girls Club of America.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night: Families Festive Prizes
videos.overview: Families (mainly consisting of only three or four members in the group) come on down to the iconic game show stage in order to play for festive prizes.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with Adam DeVine
videos.overview: In this special, Adam DeVine is playing for his charity called Children's Miracle Network where it provided much needed medical support for kids.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with Ludacris
videos.overview: In this special, rapper/actor/philanthropist Chris "Ludacris" Bridges is playing for his charity called The Ludacris Foundation.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with Lilly Singh
videos.overview: In this special, YouTuber/comedienne/late night talk show host of NBC's A Lilly Late with Lilly Singh (a.k.a "iiSuperwomanii") herself Lilly Singh is playing for her charity called Room to Read, the non-profit organization that helps millions of kids who are living in low-income communities become independent readers and supporting girls to complete school with the skills and confidence to follow their dreams.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with Tiffany Haddish
videos.overview: In this special, actress/singer/comedienne/author Tiffany Haddish is playing for her very own charity called the She Ready Foundation where it supports foster youth.

videos.title: The Price is Right 50th Anniversary Special
videos.overview: Daytime Emmy Award-winning THE PRICE IS RIGHT, network television's #1-rated daytime series and the longest-running game show in television history, celebrates its milestone 50th season with a weeklong event featuring a game each day where contestants can win up to 1 million dollars. Games include “Pay The Rent”, “Pick A Number”, “Grid Lock”.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night Celebrating the Holidays
videos.overview: Get in the holiday spirit with The Price Is Right At Night when families come on down to the iconic game show stage to play for festive prizes. Games include “Let Em Roll”, “Bargain Game”, “Shopping Spree”.

videos.title: The Price Is Right at Night - Salute to First Responders
videos.overview: An audience made up entirely of first responders - firefighters, EMTs, 911 operators, police officers and other workers on the frontlines - will be called to come on down and compete for amazing prizes, including luxury cars, vacations and more.

videos.title: The Price is Right At Night 1/19/22:The Talk Hosts Special Episode
videos.overview: This is a Special Episode of The Price Is Right At Night where THE TALK hosts Akbar Gbajabiamila, Amanda Kloots, Natalie Morales, Jerry O'Connell and Sheryl Underwood - will come on down and play alongside contestants for Feeding America, the nation's largest hunger relief charity, and contestants will compete for amazing prizes, including cash, trips and cars. and many more fun stuffs.

videos.title: The Price is Right At Night 2/14/22: Valentine's Day Episode
videos.overview: Newlywed actors Justin Hartley and Sofia Pernas "come on down" for a special primetime Valentine's Day episode.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night with Rachel Brosnahan
videos.overview: Actress Rachel Brosnahan plays alongside contestants to raise money for Covenant House.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night
videos.overview: "Young Sheldon" stars Iain Armitage and Raegan Revord are guest models with an audience full of twins.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Redemption
videos.overview: Past contestants who had losses are given a second chance to win big.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Grocery Store Employees
videos.overview: Grocery store employees have their expert knowledge of product pricing put to the test. Contestants can win incredible prizes, including an Italian getaway, an all-inclusive Costa Rican retreat, a 17-ft boat, new cars and much more.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Geniuses
videos.overview: Incredibly gifted contestants are spotlighted.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Service Industry Workers
videos.overview: Giving contestants who work for gratuity a chance to win the biggest tips of their lives.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Superfans
videos.overview: Celebrating some of the show's most passionate and dedicated viewers, from a legacy contestant whose family members are such fans that she was named after a Barker Beauty, to those with extensive memorabilia collections.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Family Night
videos.overview: Teams of kids, parents and grandparents play for chances to win prizes for the whole family, including new cars, adventure-packed trips to Paris and Jamaica, an outdoor home theater setup, $100,000 in cash and more.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night -Date Night
The Price is Right - 4th of July Special
videos.overview: It's a special primetime episode* to salute the men & women of the US Armed Forces and the Fourth of July!  The entire audience is filled with active duty members and the USAF Band of the Golden West performs.  Games include: "Pick-a-Pair", "Cliff Hangers" and "Bargain Game".

videos.title: The Price is Right: A Tribute to Bob Barker
videos.overview: A new one-hour special honoring the life and career of the beloved late television legend and animal rights activist, who was a longstanding member of the CBS family. Drew Carey, who succeeded Bob Barker as THE PRICE IS RIGHT host – and is a longtime fan and friend of Barker’s – celebrates Barker’s life and legacy as host of the tribute.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Survivor Superfans
videos.overview: "Survivor" host Jeff Probst is a special guest for an audience of "Survivor" show superfans.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - The Amazing Race  Superfans
videos.overview: It’s an Amazing Race special with an audience of superfan duos vying for cash & prizes!

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night
videos.overview: It's a Girls Night Out with an audience of gal pals trying to win fantastic prizes!

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Mothers-in-Law Edition
videos.overview: It's a Mothers-in-Law show with an audience of moms & kids in law working together for cash & fantastic prizes!

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night: Grandparents
videos.overview: Tonight, on The Price is Right at Night grandparents, their kids and grandkids team up to break the bank and win fantastic prizes! In the call-downs, the grandparent’s name is first.

videos.title: The Price is Right at Night - Office Holiday Party
videos.overview: Tonight, on The Price is Right at Night it’s an Office Holiday Party!

videos.title: June 14th, 2007 (Barker final week #4)
